links.comparator_used: Source-trained model applied to the target without adaptation (also compared with pooled training and calibration-only updating)
links.outcome: ROC-AUC and Expected Calibration Error on younger children (Experiment A); mortality prediction from vital signs
links.effect: Random Forest ROC-AUC 0.725 (0.703-0.746) without adaptation vs 0.867 (0.842-0.890) after target-domain retraining; ECE 0.142 vs below 0.01. Retraining on only 5% of the target pool (about 180 patients) recovered most of the gap. Calibration-only updating corrected ECE but did not restore discrimination.
links.tradeoff: Requires labelled target-cohort data (50% of target data in the main analysis). Calibration-only updating was insufficient for discrimination.
links.quote: The strongest discrimination evidence comes from the fully observed Experiment A: Random Forest ROC-AUC fell from 0.940 (95% CI 0.912-0.968) on older children to 0.725 (0.703-0.746) on younger children, and target-domain retraining recovered 0.867 (0.842-0.890); ECE rose from ≤0.010 to 0.142 and was restored below 0.01.

design_hint: target-domain retraining and recalibration before pediatric deployment
